slides.takeaway: Same branch requests and stock-exact histograms. Wall time includes startup and output.
slides.notes: This independent progression compares end-to-end full-systematics direct commands. Each arm is a fresh process and each scope uses the same original events and branch-set digest. The histogram is exact against stock for each job. The displayed means and sample SD use three retained runs after one warmup. An asterisk marks a spread failure. This progression compares bundled configurations. It cannot assign an isolated speedup to one mechanism.
